source_policy: Cherry-pick or adapt upstream functionality only; no wholesale source replacement, no reset of published release, fail on patch drift.
required_preservation: approved app-specific Android UI and launcher icon
fonts SAF import, shared folder, recursive refresh
touch, trackpad and stylus controls where supported
app identity, data/recovery and file associations
existing GPU optimizations and adaptive frame pacing
test_policy: Disposable-key-signed ARM64 separate test package, build only after a reviewed compatible source integration; never publish automatically.
